context: Evaluates correct use of Uppy's event system for handling upload lifecycle events. Tests whether upload-success correctly extracts file and response.body, and whether upload-error uses uppy.info() with the right arguments including fallback error message logic.

checklist.name: upload-success event registered
checklist.description: uppyInstance.on('upload-success', handler) is used to register the success handler.

checklist.name: Success callback with file + body
checklist.description: The success handler calls onUploadSuccess({ file, metadata: response.body }) with both file and the response body as the metadata.

checklist.name: Guard on file and response.body
checklist.description: The success handler checks that both file and response.body are truthy before calling the callback.

checklist.name: upload-error event registered
checklist.description: uppyInstance.on('upload-error', handler) is used to register the error handler.

checklist.name: Error message fallback logic
checklist.description: The error message is extracted as response?.body?.error || error.message, preferring the response body's error field.

checklist.name: uppy.info() call signature
checklist.description: uppy.info() is called with three arguments: the error message string, 'error', and 5000 (ms).
